summary: Phase 3 (AI Stylist + Attach-a-piece, reorganised Profile, rebuilt Monthly Wardrobe Health, Shopping Intelligence via Profile) verified end-to-end. 100% pass across 7 pytest backend cases and 30+ Playwright UI assertions on the reviewer account (review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable>) at 390x844. BACKEND (pytest, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration46_phase3.py — 7/7 in 25.1s): (1) POST /api/stylist/chat vague 'what should I wear tonight?' returns {reply, outfit:null, needs_context:true} with a single '?' question and NO AI spend; (2) with item_ids=[<real T-shirt id>] the reply references the attached piece by name ('White Crew T-Shirt') and never trips needs_context; (3) unknown item_ids are silently ignored — request still returns a valid reply (200); (4) an explicit-occasion 'complete outfit' request returns 200 and, when the outfit JSON block is emitted, resolves to real wardrobe ids with the {name,item_ids,items} shape; (5) GET /api/insights returns slim thumbnails on most_worn/least_worn (no orig_photo field) plus the new month block {label,wears_logged,pieces_worn,top_worn:[{item,wears}],unworn:[items]} — all fields present and typed correctly and no orig_photo leaks through; (6) POST /api/wear (with 2 items + name) increments month.wears_logged by exactly 1, keeps month.pieces_worn monotonic, and puts the just-worn ids into month.top_worn; POST /api/dressme in the same window does NOT change wears_logged/pieces_worn (suggestions never touch wear_logs); (7) POST /api/insights/health-report returns 200 with headline/lesson/nudges/wins/missing_piece for the premium account. FRONTEND (Playwright, 390x844, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL through the emergent preview): STYLIST — /stylist opens with the brand mark, 'AI Stylist' title, the 'attach a piece' intro copy and all 4 conversational starters (stylist-suggest-help-circle/edit-3/layers/briefcase); sending 'What would you change about my navy blazer?' returns a wardrobe-aware reply that mentions blazer/navy within ~15s; ATTACH FLOW — stylist-attach opens the wardrobe sheet, stylist-attach-search is visible, 16 stylist-piece-<id> tiles render, tapping the first adds a chip (stylist-attached), sending 'How would you style the piece I attached?' returns a piece-specific reply ('What are you dressing the White Crew T-Shirt for—casual daytime, work, or going out?'), and the chip is removable (0 chips after remove tap). PROFILE — /profile: all required testIDs present (profile-switcher-trigger, open-style-profile, profile-calendar-cta, subscription-card, open-health-report, open-shopping-intelligence, how-aureve-works, sign-out, wardrobe-audit, privacy-policy, terms, delete-account); EXACTLY ONE profile-switcher-trigger; only ONE sign-out (in the ACCOUNT section, none in the top account card); no 'Switch account' text anywhere; the Pieces/Looks/Profiles metric row is GONE (0 body occurrences); reviewer is Premium so manage-subscription renders and go-premium is absent (0 count) — matches spec. HEALTH REPORT (/health-report, premium) — month title 'September 2026', three tiles ('1 outfits worn / 4 pieces in rotation / 12 never worn yet'), health-most-worn strip with wear counts ('1× this month' × 4 pieces incl. Black Silk Blouse/Beige Chino/Tan Ankle Boots), health-unworn strip (White Crew T-Shirt / Light Blue Oxford / Cream Ribbed / Indigo Bottoms), health-nudges, health-wins and health-next-buy all render after the async AI call. SHOPPING INTELLIGENCE — open-shopping-intelligence routes to /shop and shop-back is visible + tappable, brand mark renders. DELETE MODAL — delete-account opens the confirm modal (confirm-delete + cancel-delete both present); cancelled, no deletion attempted. STYLE PROFILE — open-style-profile routes to /profile-edit. SIGN OUT — sign-out actually signs out and lands on /welcome. HOME REGRESSION — home-action-wardrobe/create/dressme/stylist + home-collections + home-collections-saved/worn all visible, tab bar unobstructed, no clipping at 390x844. Only pre-existing harmless RN-Web deprecation warnings persist (shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2004-2012 attached-pieces line is composed as 'THE USER IS ASKING ABOUT THESE SPECIFIC PIECES: <name> (id <id>, <category>, <colour>); ... Talk about these pieces directly.' — verified at runtime that the reply then names the attached garment (White Crew T-Shirt) instead of giving generic advice.

server.py:1992-1994 needs_occasion_context short-circuits BEFORE enforce_limit('stylist') and BEFORE ai_chat — vague 'what should I wear tonight?' costs the user nothing, confirmed by the 200/needs_context:true response with a single question.

server.py:3306-3337 month block uses now_utc().strftime('%Y-%m') to filter wear_logs by string prefix on created_at — verified only /api/wear updates the counters (POST /api/dressme in the same test window did NOT move wears_logged or pieces_worn).

server.py:3287 items query already projects out orig_photo, and slim_items_by_id yields thumb-only photo fields for most_worn/least_worn/month.top_worn/month.unworn — asserted no orig_photo leaks in any response arm.

app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:117 profile-switcher-trigger renders exactly once (count=1); the top account card at lines 103-115 has NO sign-out icon (the only testID='sign-out' is on line 234 inside ACCOUNT); no 'Switch account' row is defined; the Pieces/Looks/Profiles metric row was removed and no traces remain in the DOM.
app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:59-69 manageSubscription falls back to /premium on Platform.OS==='web' — acceptable and explicitly permitted by the review request.

app/health-report.tsx:71-104 layout renders `health-most-worn` when insights.month.top_worn is non-empty and `health-no-wears` otherwise — verified with 1 recorded wear the strip appears with '1× this month' labels.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every Phase-3 UI assertion passed at 390x844: stylist conversational reply + attached-piece flow, Profile removals (no stats row / no top sign-out / one switcher / no 'Switch account'), premium subscription card, health-report full render (tiles + most/unworn strips + nudges + wins + next-buy), shop with working back control, delete confirm modal opens (not confirmed), style-profile nav, sign-out lands on /welcome, home regression clean.

Pre-existing harmless RN-Web warnings ('shadow*', 'props.pointerEvents') still present, ignore.
rca_of_issue: N/A — full Phase 3 verification pass, no regressions detected. AI Stylist attach flow is deterministic: server.py inserts an explicit 'THE USER IS ASKING ABOUT THESE SPECIFIC PIECES: ...' line into the prompt so the model names the piece; unknown ids are filtered by an id-membership check against the user's wardrobe; the vague-question guardrail runs before enforce_limit/ai_chat so free users are not charged for a re-ask. Monthly Health counts are strictly wear_log-derived (not derived from suggestions or saved outfits), so /api/dressme cannot inflate them.
